questions.explanation: Profit maximization focuses on setting prices that will yield the highest profit margins. This is essential for the sustainability of the business.

questions.stem: Which pricing method involves adding a fixed percentage to the cost of a product?
questions.explanation: Cost-plus pricing is a straightforward method where a fixed percentage is added to the cost to determine the selling price.

distractorRationale.a: Option a is incorrect as break-even pricing focuses on covering costs, not adding a percentage.
distractorRationale.b: Option c is wrong because going-rate pricing is based on competitors' prices, not cost.
distractorRationale.c: Option d is not correct since perceived-value pricing is based on customer perception, not cost.

questions.stem: What is a key feature of break-even pricing?

options.text: It sets prices based on competition.

questions.explanation: Break-even pricing is designed to set a price that covers all costs, ensuring that the business does not incur a loss.

distractorRationale.a: Option a is incorrect because maximizing profit is not the goal of break-even pricing.
distractorRationale.b: Option c is wrong as break-even pricing does not consider competitors' prices.
distractorRationale.c: Option d is not correct since it does not focus on customer perception.
